sections.heading: The Club at Paradise Point - An All Hands Venue
sections.markdown: Set on the beautiful New River shoreline, The Club at Paradise Point offers an all-ranks venue suitable for all kinds of ceremonies, parties, or celebrations. The Club features the Follow Me Bar, The Wooden Nickel, and our famous all-hands lunch buffet. And don't forget to get your fresh-baked bread weekly!

sections.heading: Buy Fresh Bread at The Club weekly!
sections.markdown:
Order by 4PM Wed., pickup from Noon-9PM Friday.

$3.50 per loaf

Call to order: (910) 450-7981

sections.heading: All Hands Lunch Buffet
sections.markdown:
**Monday | 11AM - 1PM**

Every Monday Lunch Buffet is a slimmer version of our traditional buffet at a slimmer price. Includes one each of protein, starch, vegetable, soup, salad, roll, dessert & soda / tea / coffee.

$10.95 per person

**Tuesday- Friday | 11AM - 1PM**

Dine in: $12.95 per person, all you can eat.

Takeout: $9.50 for the first pound, 60¢ each additional ounce.

sections.heading: The Wooden Nickel
sections.markdown:
Located in The Club at Paradise Point, The Wooden Nickel features a wide range of cuisines and drinks. Whether you're enjoying a meal with your family or having a drink after work.

The Wooden Nickel will be open from 5-9PM on Saturdays when there is a DJ/Karaoke Party scheduled.

Take-out available.

[Learn More about The Wooden Nickel](/dining-entertainment/clubs/the-club-at-paradise-point/the-wooden-nickel)
